links.outcome: LLM accuracy, safety, and diagnostic performance on AILD questions and real-world cases, by model
links.effect: o1-preview had the greatest proportion of accurate responses (78.3%), highest mean safety score; diagnostic accuracy 81.0%, outperforming GPT-4o and GPT-3.5-Turbo.
links.quote: In diagnostic testing, the o1-preview achieved an overall accuracy of 81.0%, outperforming GPT-4o and GPT-3.5-Turbo, particularly in single-entity AILD diagnoses.

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of LLMs on confirmed AILD cases, including overlap syndrome
links.effect: o1-preview overall diagnostic accuracy 81.0%; all models showed reduced diagnostic accuracy for AIH-PBC overlap syndrome.
links.quote: All models demonstrated reduced diagnostic accuracy for autoimmune hepatitis-primary biliary cholangitis overlap syndrome.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy, safety, and diagnostic performance of multiple LLMs on autoimmune liver disease clinical questions and retrospective cases assessed by hepatologists, but it does not test a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
